title: Entity (endid)
description: An endid is a thing the substrate knows about — the anchor for claims; it does not itself assert facts. This schema mirrors the entity-table contract the live awen-weave validator enforces (craidd.schema.entity_types.VALID_ENTITY_TYPES + storage/ddl.py entity CHECK, SCHEMA_VERSION v0.1). The fifteen v0.1 entity types are closed. `place_anchor` and `labels` are constitution/interface-layer optional extensions (interface-contract §2/§4), NOT columns in the v0.1 code entity table — they are omitted by live entities and do not affect round-trip; see compatibility.md.

entity_id.description: Stable entity id (PK), instance-scoped. The code does not constrain its format.

entity_type.description: One of the fifteen v0.1 controlled entity types (entity_types.py VALID_ENTITY_TYPES / DDL CHECK). street & area have no dedicated seed predicates yet; person is declared but not pre-populated. `site` (added 0.1.4, ratified by the Llys 25/07/2026): a bounded parcel or development site considered as a subject in its own right — the thing a planning application, an allocation or an opportunity assessment is ABOUT. Distinct from `area` (an administrative or designated boundary) and from `building` (a structure): a site may hold no building and may span several. `station` (added 0.1.5, ratified by the Llys 06/08/2026): an environmental monitoring facility — a fixed point (gauge/sensor/station) that observations are taken AT and attach to — anchored to INSPIRE `EnvironmentalMonitoringFacility`. Distinct from `site` (a parcel/development subject) and `building` (a structure): a station is the measurement facility itself, the subject a hydrology or air-quality observation is about. `coastal_cell` (added 0.1.6, ratified by the Llys 07/08/2026): a coastal/marine management unit — a sediment cell or Shoreline Management Plan policy unit — considered as a subject in its own right, the stretch of coast a shoreline policy, coastal-erosion projection or sea-level figure is ABOUT. Anchored to the Defra SMP sediment-cell framework (Wales = Cell 11). Distinct from `area` (an administrative/designated land boundary) and `station` (a fixed monitoring point): a coastal cell is the marine/coastal spine the estate's coastal indicators attach to. `nhs_org` (added 0.1.10, Huw Thomas, as Llys, 13/10/2026): an NHS organisation identified by its NHS Organisation Data Service (ODS) code, considered as a subject in its own right: a GP practice, a branch surgery or other site, or a health board. Its role is a claim about it, not a separate type (Llys 10/10/2026 [sig:8f0740b4]). It is NOT a place (grain `not_spatial`, Llys 10/10/2026 [sig:3cc4cb54]): where its premises are is carried as stated claims about it. Distinct from `building` (a structure) and `area` (a boundary): the board that contains a practice's premises is not thereby the board that runs it. Written `nhs_org:<ODS code>`; a bare code is refused by awen-weave and the registry, never typed by its shape (Llys 10/10/2026 [sig:02dd6f4c]). `cluster` (added 0.1.10, same ruling): a GP cluster, a publisher-defined group of practices, keyed by the publisher's own code and written `cluster:<publisher code>`. Not a place (`not_spatial`); a practice's membership is a claim on the practice. Distinct from `area`: a cluster is a group of organisations, not a boundary. `care_establishment` (added 0.1.11, Huw Thomas, as Llys, 26/10/2026, [sig:d458cafe], ratified [sig:0ad68cf6]): a health or social care establishment, with premises the public attends, as a Welsh regulator registers it (Healthcare Inspectorate Wales or Care Inspectorate Wales), considered as a subject in its own right. It is NOT an NHS body or unit: an establishment run by an NHS body is an `nhs_org`. It does not cover a service without such premises or one delivered at a private dwelling (domiciliary support, childminding), nor any further service type until ruled. Its type, sector and services are claims about it. It is NOT a place (grain `not_spatial`): where its premises are is carried as stated claims about it. Distinct from `nhs_org` (where an establishment is also on an ODS list, the two stay separate subjects and a claim links them) and from `building` (a structure; several establishments may share one). Written `care_establishment:<register>-<id>`, all lower case: `hiw-m` and four digits for a minted id (HIW publishes none), the register's own identifier normalised for a register that publishes one (CIW: its service URN); the minted form `m` and digits is reserved, never a published id. A bare id is refused by awen-weave and the registry, never typed by its shape.

uprn.description: OS Unique Property Reference Number (DDL BIGINT). Nullable — most are null until Town Dataset / Lleolydd coverage resolves them.

toid.description: OS MasterMap TopographicArea TOID, where known.

visibility.description: Entity visibility. DDL CHECK (public/restricted/private OR NULL). Only meaningful for `source` entities — validate_entity rejects a non-null visibility on any other type (see cross-rule below).

created_at.description: When the entity was created (DDL DEFAULT NOW()).

place_anchor.description: Constitution/interface-layer OPTIONAL extension — the geographic joint between instances (interface-contract §2/§4). Not a v0.1 code entity column.

labels.description: Constitution/interface-layer OPTIONAL extension: bilingual display labels. Not a v0.1 code entity column — in code, names live as name_cy/name_en claims.

source_kind.description: The closed domain of the `source` entity's `source_kind` predicate (Llys 01/10/2026, placement A; constitution 0.1.9). Referenced by no property here, so it validates nothing on an entity row: it is the ONE machine-readable copy of the six values, in the only directory every vendored tree carries. awen-weave builds the predicate's constraint_json from it and refuses an off-domain value in validate_claim; Porth's constitution_validate does not (no per-predicate value rule in SCH-CLAIM-001). POL-TIERAB-001's `source_kinds` is a Rego copy tied to this one by tests/test_release_0_1_9.py. No `unknown` value: an absent kind means not known, and fails closed (not tier_a_eligible).

then.description: A non-null visibility is only valid on a source entity (validate_entity).
